status: Dataset preparation and official evaluator integration; no benchmark accuracy run launched
method_constraints: No new confidence gates, adaptive/tuned thresholds, frame-quality selection or temporal subsampling. Preserve native SAM2 mask-logit conversion and built-in presence behavior. Ordinary training and any regional mechanism retain native memory reads.

davis2017.format: Indexed persistent multi-object masks; ignore label255; original first-frame prompt for every object
davis2017.role: External-to-PolypGen benchmark, not proof of exclusion from foundation-model training; audit published SAM2 data overlap

sav.format: Per-object binary PNGs with possible overlap, including object000; do not merge or remap IDs
sav.timing: Propagate all24fps JPEG frames; score only annotated6fps frames, excluding first/last annotated masks via author evaluator
sav.role: Val for engineering only; freeze one PolypGen configuration before reporting test. Never train/tune the adapter on SA-V test.

implementation: Reuse pinned SAM2 tools/vos_inference.py mask I/O unchanged and official evaluators. Dataset inventory/commands are project orchestration, not a replacement metric or new network.
metrics: Official J, F and J&F primary for literature comparison; framewise Dice supplementary. Retain per-object/sequence results and denominators. Do not infer mean Dice from mean IoU or compare aggregate published J&F as a paired local experiment.
baselines: Use compatible published numbers where available, with source/backbone/checkpoint/split/precision/prompt recorded. Matched native predictions are necessary for missing Dice or paired local statistics. No redundant third-party full reruns by default.
engineering_before_accuracy: Official first-frame prompts and persistent IDs, including SA-V000
SA-V overlap preserved and unannotated frames retained during propagation
Dataset-specific native-vs-integrated replay and zero-change identity
First/last annotation exclusions and void pixels agree with official evaluator
Exact frame/instance coverage, finite predictions, fixed source/checkpoint provenance
storage: Dataset archives, extracted files and all experiment outputs on Google Drive filesystem only.
